_README: TEST PROFILES. A profile names which tests a given phase's deterministic suite runs, and every
test it does NOT run is listed here with an owner, a phase and a reason. That is the whole
point: before this file existed there was no selection mechanism at all, so later-phase tests
were not excluded from the Phase C suite — they were simply failing in it, and 'known failure'
was a thing people remembered rather than a thing the repository recorded.
An exclusion here is a debt with a name on it, never a way to make a red test disappear.
every_exclusion_still_matches_a_test.test.mjs asserts that each entry below still matches a real
test that still exists, so an exclusion cannot outlive its subject and quietly suppress a
future failure with the same name.
npm test              every test in the repository, nothing excluded
npm run test:phase-d  the Phase D deterministic suite, zero-cost, exclusions below applied

phase-d.description: The Phase D deterministic suite: Phase A, effective Phase B, and Phase C runtime and evidence tests. Runs under the zero-cost contract with no paid-AI provider reachable and no external-effect path active.
